rows.quote: Genetic association data for HCC were sourced from the FinnGen cohort (finngen‐R11‐HCC, with 609 patients and 345,118 controls; https://www.finngen.fi/en/) [23] and the IEU OpenGWAS project (ieu‐b‐4953, with 168 patients and 372,016 controls; https://gwas.mrcieu.ac.uk/datasets/) (Table 1).
rows.coder_note: Step 2 of the decision order (rules A, C4, H). The identifier finngen-R11-HCC carries the prefix finngen_R11 that the FinnGen R11 row lists, written with hyphens: rule C4 case one (a listed prefix, nothing conflicts). The counts 609 patients and 345,118 controls are endpoint-specific and equal no other release's N, so they are no conflict under rule H.

rows.quote: METHODS: Genetic association data for circulating plasma proteins and 2821 protein-to-protein ratios were sourced from the UKB PPP and Suhre's study.
rows.coder_note: Step 3 of the decision order (rule C2). The sentence names Suhre's study as the source of 2821 protein-to-protein ratio associations; the pqtl side of the dictionary has no row for a protein-ratio study by Suhre under any release (its only Suhre row is the 2017 KORA study of 1,124 proteins, which the sentence does not describe).

Step 4 of the decision order (rules D, C5 not met). The sentence attributes the data to reference 22, a 2022 bioRxiv preprint (doi 10.1101/2022.06.17.496443) whose identifier is not one of any dictionary row, so the citation cannot carry a code; Table 1 gives an approximate sample size (54,000) and European population, which pick no single row.
